evidence.summary: Live on this PC: block detected 74s after launch; tunnel held in 'blocked' with no restart between attempts; one fresh attempt per ~30 min (09:56 launch 1, then 10:27 ... 13:28, 13:59) vs every 10 min on the old code (09:07-09:48). When the network began allowing 7844, the 13:59:02 fresh attempt registered: 13:59:43 'port 7844 no longer blocked', tunnel healthy, public /login 200 and /auth/me 401, and the blocked fields were cleared in status.json. API, web and worker were healthy throughout. Stub test 38/0. Self-verification by the implementation run.

rationale: Measured live on both sides: the hold on the blocking network (2 link changes an hour instead of 6) and the return to normal on /ready 200. Not observable: whether the held process would have registered by itself without the fresh attempt.
